AnnouncementSubtitles.ANN_T1_Intro_01: Hello Superstructure Worker, and welcome to the Training Sector, located in Substructure 05. Please enjoy your time here knowing that your skills are valuable to the Superstructure Research Authority.[AS]
AnnouncementSubtitles.ANN_T1_Generic_Warning_LiveRounds: Warning: Training Hazards are generally safe, though at your own choice some do use live rounds. The Authority would like to stress that bullets are not safe, and being shot can be deadly.[AS]
AnnouncementSubtitles.ANN_T1_Generic_SafetyTip_Up: Safety Tip: If you find yourself in the deepest parts of the Superstructure, the best way out is usually up. If you don't know which way to go, assume up.[AS]
AnnouncementSubtitles.ANN_T1_Generic_SafetyTip_UnderThreat: Safety Tip: When under threat, it is better to use the tools you have available to you to escape, rather than save them and die in the moment.[AS]
AnnouncementSubtitles.ANN_T1_Generic_SafetyTip_HammerDefence: Safety Tip: Your Hammer can be used in the case of self defence. Any physical exotic, or mechanical dangers such as but not limited to: Tongues, Tendrils, Arms, and Eyes, are effective targets in case of threat.[AS]
AnnouncementSubtitles.ANN_T1_Generic_SafetyTip_Escape: Safety Tip: The most effective tool against most threats is to escape. If you feel threatened, climb.[AS]
AnnouncementSubtitles.ANN_T1_Generic_SafetyTip_Dangerous: Safety Tip: If you see something dangerous, don't.[AS]
AnnouncementSubtitles.ANN_T1_Generic_Reminder_SurfaceContacts:
Reminder: The Research Authority is still determined to make contact with remaining surface governmental or civilian groups, if any exist.
If you had loved ones on the surface, there is a chance they are still alive. Continue your work, for them.[AS]
AnnouncementSubtitles.ANN_T1_Generic_Reminder_ResearchSafe: Reminder: Substructure 05 is a designated 'research safe' facility, meant to train employees of the SRA and the ITAA in everything from High-Energy Explosives, Periphery Research, AI Handling, and Superstructure Exploration.[AS]
AnnouncementSubtitles.ANN_T1_Generic_Reminder_Infinite: Reminder: Due to the effects of the local Periphery, each training sector is effectively infinite. If you feel the facility moving under your feet, do not panic, that is the facility rearranging itself to better suit your needs.[AS]
AnnouncementSubtitles.ANN_T1_Generic_Reminder_HumanValuable: Reminder: Be careful when climbing through the Superstructure. Every remaining human life is endlessly valuable, and your collective effort will ensure that we have the tools for humanity's survival.[AS]
AnnouncementSubtitles.ANN_T1_Generic_Reminder_EventsonSurface: Reminder: Due to events on the surface, employees have reported feelings of depression and despondency. Do not let it effect your work.[AS]
AnnouncementSubtitles.ANN_T1_Generic_Reminder_Dopplegangers: Warning: Some trainees have reported seeing doppelgangers of themselves in the facility. Do not panic, they are perfectly benign, safe, and incapable of any thought. If you feel uncomfortable, they can be easily dispatched by breaking in their skulls.[AS]
AnnouncementSubtitles.ANN_T1_Generic_Reminder_December15th:

The Authority wants you to know that those lost gave their lives for the safety and continuation of Humanity.[AS]

...
